map.投喂率为何随水温变化？: Why does the feeding rate vary with water temperature?
map.鱼类代谢随水温升高而增强，适温区间内投喂率提高；过高或过低水温应降低甚至停喂。: Fish metabolism increases as the water warms, so the feeding rate rises within the optimum range; at too high or too low a temperature, reduce it or stop feeding.
map.每次投多少合适？: How much is right per meal?
map.以 30 分钟内吃完、不剩料为原则，过量会败坏水质并浪费饲料。: Aim for everything eaten within 30 minutes with no leftover feed; excess spoils the water and wastes feed.
